headline: Sunday keeps its shoes off.
body: The first hour of the week arrives without a headline of its own. A radiator ticks once and thinks better of it. Paper on the blotter still smells faintly of ink.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: a lid of cloud, no moon to argue

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet kerb, one bus two stops late

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: the desk lamp’s small gold circle
